topic: Types of Environments and Earth Materials
key_concepts: Mountain, river, and beach are types of environments
Each environment has different living and non-living things
A mountain environment is high land with steep sides and contains rocks and soil
A river environment has flowing fresh water and organisms such as frogs and plants
A beach environment has sand and crabs and normally lacks fresh water
Non-living materials in environments include rocks, soil, sand, and water
Earth materials include rocks, water, minerals, and fossil fuels
Coal, oil, and gas are fossil fuels
Rocks are used for building walls
Water is used for washing and watering plants
Minerals are used to make jewelry
Fossil fuels are used to make cars run
